_comment: Preserved C-first setup miss for the intended dig.c:zap_dig downward grave route. At the starting square the feature wish reported “Can't place a grave here”; engrave.c:make_grave only accepts ROOM/GRAVE terrain without a trap. The later zap prompt offered inventory letters c and n, so the frozen “o” selected no object. Its C recording is retained as a missed setup and is not dig_up_grave evidence.
